loc_discipline.evidence: app.py remains a single-file app with embedded frontend, HTTP server, multipart parser, and conversion logic.

validation_coverage.evidence: Upload size, file extension, MIME prefix, fps, width, encoder, loop, time range, ffprobe-readable duration, max clip duration, and estimated output frames are validated. Actual media trust still relies on ffprobe/native decoders.
validation_coverage.routes_with_schema: convert route has explicit validation helpers

secrets_hygiene.evidence: No credentials in repo. Cloudflare Tunnel credentials are expected to live outside the repository.

state_persistence.evidence: jobs dict and output GIFs are local and ephemeral. jobs_lock, cleanup loop, MAX_JOBS, and output TTL reduce growth but do not persist state across restart.

errors_retry_idempotency.evidence: Server returns clear validation/resource errors. Frontend handles upload/polling/network failures. No retry or idempotency layer.

testing_ci.evidence: Focused unit tests cover validation, loop values, clip limits, and conversion slot behavior. No CI configuration.
